We are looking for a structured, analytical and proactive individual to independently manage lower\-complexity projects and to support Project Managers in the execution and governance of larger Change, Transformation and Transition (Lift\-Out) initiatives across Global Client Delivery (GCD) locations. The ideal candidate will bring clarity through data, planning and disciplined tracking in environments where stakeholders and requirements are still evolving, ensuring that Business Leads, Tech Leads and cross\-functional teams have an accurate and timely view of progress, risks and decisions. The role is the analytical and governance engine of the Projects team – owning project plans, RAID logs, toll\-gate evidence, KPI and capacity reporting and the project management tooling that the team runs on. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Head of Projects.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Project Planning \& Execution Support
  
  

Independently manage assigned low\-to\-medium complexity projects (e.g. Transition Lite work transfers, single\-workstream change or process improvement initiatives, ad hoc GCD initiatives) from discovery through to closure, using the SWAT and Toll Gate frameworks
  
Act as the delivery partner to a Project Manager on large or critical Transition and Transformation projects, owning defined workstreams, deliverables and follow\-ups end to end
  
Build and maintain integrated project plans, milestone schedules and detailed transition plans (deliverables, dates and named owners) and keep them baselined and current as scope evolves
  
Track delivery against scope, schedule and success criteria and flag variances to the Project Manager / Head of Projects early, with proposed corrective actions
  
  

Governance, Toll Gates \& Decision Support

Prepare materials for Tier 2 (weekly tactical) and Tier 3 (operational) governance forums – agendas, status packs, action and decision logs – and facilitate Tier 3 forums for projects you own
  
Maintain decision logs capturing what was decided, by whom (Business / Tech / PM), when and why, and follow through on resulting actions
  
Contribute to the Tier 1 (monthly strategic oversight) and PMO review packs by consolidating status, risks, escalations and change requests across the portfolio
  
  

Risk, Issue, Dependency \& Action Management
  
  

Maintain the RAID log (risks, assumptions/actions, issues, dependencies) for assigned projects, categorising by type (business / technical / execution) and impact, and driving owners to closure
  
Analyse trends across risks and issues to identify systemic blockers and cross\-project dependencies, and bring them to the Project Manager / Head of Projects with options
  
Prepare escalation notes that clearly state the blocker, impact, options and decision required, for use in the appropriate governance tier
  
Co\-create mitigation plans with Business Leads, Tech Leads and cross\-functional teams (TA, Academy, IT, Risk, Legal \& Compliance, Control Tower)
  
  

Reporting, KPIs \& Capacity Analytics
  
  

Produce accurate, insight\-led status reporting – weekly project updates, executive dashboards and the consolidated GCD Projects weekly update – for the Head of Projects, Executive Sponsors and Business / Tech Leads
  
Define, collect and analyse project KPIs (timeline adherence, milestone delivery, hiring and onboarding progress, KC/KT scorecards, controlled production results) and turn them into clear recommendations
  
Support capacity and headcount reporting – tracking Budget\-to\-Hire, FTE moves across locations and GCD location capacity utilisation in partnership with Control Tower and Workforce Planning
  
Build and maintain Power BI / Excel dashboards and reporting templates so that portfolio\-level reporting is consistent, repeatable and largely automated
  
  

Stakeholder Coordination \& Communication
  
  

Coordinate day\-to\-day with Business Leads, Tech Leads, CD Leads, Transformation Leads and cross\-functional teams across global delivery locations to gather inputs, validate status and close actions
  
Maintain living stakeholder maps and RACI for assigned projects, identifying stakeholders that emerge during execution and adjusting engagement accordingly

Surface business decisions to Business Leads and technical decisions to Tech Leads, while taking execution\-level decisions within the agreed plan independently
  
  

Scope, Change \& Transition Support
  
  

Support scope discovery and Control Tower intake – helping LoB / BPAs complete intake forms, documenting scope, assumptions and impacted teams, and highlighting overlaps, gaps or conflicts
  
Log, assess and track change requests, including impact on timeline, effort and headcount, and route them through the appropriate approval tier
  
Track Knowledge Capture / Knowledge Transfer (KC/KT) execution, training completion and access provisioning against plan for transitions from global high\-cost locations to Client Delivery centres
  
Prepare Go/No\-Go readiness assessments and support post\-project reviews, capturing lessons learnt and feeding them back into the team's frameworks, checklists and templates
  
  

PMO Frameworks, Tools \& Continuous Improvement
  
  

Administer and continuously improve the team's project management toolset – Jira boards and workflows, Confluence project spaces, SharePoint evidence libraries and reporting templates
  
Maintain the Transition Framework, Transition Checklist, SWAT templates and Transition Acceptance Document templates, incorporating lessons learnt and stakeholder feedback
